P1.reason: B separates move legality, marking, noop turn-passing, and each win line (row, column, diagonal) into recognisable rules; A lumps win detection, ending and scoring together.

differences.reason: Hurts: merges row, column, diagonal wins, board-full ending and goals into one oversized group.
Hurts: mixes who may move and noop with the board-update effect of marking.
Helps: gathers game ending and winner scoring, though it mixes terminal with goals and open.
Helps: a clear 'mark a blank cell' rule, legality plus its effect on the board.
Helps: a clean statement of legal moves, including passing when it is not your turn.
Helps: diagonal win line as its own rule, connected to line.
Helps: noop for the waiting player is a nameable turn-taking detail; slightly redundant with B3.
Helps: row win line as a distinct rule.
Helps: column win line as a distinct rule.
